decision: stream the WGS source and release WES/RNA sources after validation

problem.summary: The production run did not fit the project allocation by roughly an order of magnitude.
problem.detail: roihu_stage_inputs.sbatch downloaded and retained every source file, and roihu_prune_sample_work.sh released only the Nextflow work directory. A single 30x WGS CRAM is roughly 18 GB, so even the standard two-sample WGS pilot exceeded the headroom.

changes.change: WGS staging reads the source CRAM over HTTPS and writes only the mate-aware HLA BAM.
changes.why_safe: workflow/main.nf already requires input_type=bam for WGS and the callers already consume the extracted BAM, so no caller sees anything different. Only the means of producing that BAM changed.
changes.enabled_by: samtools 1.21 on Roihu is built with libcurl=yes S3=yes GCS=yes and plugins=no, so remote handlers are compiled in and HTS_PATH is not needed. This supersedes the relocated samtools 1.15.1 bundle the earlier EGCC pilot required.

changes.change: After a sample validates, release the staged WES/RNA source in addition to the Nextflow work directory.
changes.why_safe: The frozen manifest pins input_uri, source_checksum and index_checksum, and staged_files_sha256.txt is retained, so a released input is re-fetchable and re-verifiable.
changes.not_applied_to: The WGS mate-aware BAM, which under streaming is the only surviving artifact of the extraction and is small.

changes.change: Measure peak disk before the release and retained disk after it.
changes.why: The storage gate multiplies retained bytes by the full cohort size. A retained figure taken before the release would describe a state that never persists and would make the projection meaningless. Peak is still taken while everything is on disk, so both projections stay honest.

changes.change: The pilot wave now runs in sequential_low_storage rather than full_scale.
changes.why: With the measurement reordering above, pruning happens between the peak and retained measurements, so a pilot in production mode yields correct inputs to both projections. It also stops pilots permanently consuming the headroom.

what_was_not_changed.wes_caller_input: WES callers still consume the CRAM itself. Substituting an extracted BAM would change what every WES caller sees, which is a scientific change and not a storage fix. It was not made.
what_was_not_changed.reserve: The 100 GiB reserve is unchanged. If the storage gate returns blocked, the allocation is escalated or the wave reduced; the reserve is not reduced to force a pass.

verification_strength_reduction.what: For streamed WGS samples the source CRAM checksum is no longer independently reverified, because the file is never on disk to hash.
verification_strength_reduction.recorded_where: Each sample writes streamed_source.json with source_checksum_declared, source_checksum_verified=false, source_retained=false, the verified index checksum and the extracted BAM checksum.
verification_strength_reduction.residual_verification: The index is fetched and checksum-verified, the extracted BAM is checksummed, samtools quickcheck runs on the unsorted and sorted BAM, and staged_files_sha256.txt records everything retained.
verification_strength_reduction.disclosure: This is a real reduction in verification strength and is stated in configs/roihu_site.json and in the per-sample record rather than left implicit.

acceptance_test.claim: A streamed extraction produces the same read set as download-then-extract.
acceptance_test.method: Run both paths on HG00096 and compare sorted SAM records by SHA-256.
acceptance_test.note: The storage fix rests entirely on this claim, so it is verified on a real sample before anything depends on it.
